purpose: Freeze a geography/DEM-only candidate pool before any 2015 control-outcome adjudication.

corridor.downstream_end: MML 2013 R9 Puente California mainstem anchor

candidate_rule.definition: A candidate is the strongest non-mainstem D8 feeder entering each traversed Rímac mainstem cell between the frozen upstream and downstream corridor anchors.
candidate_rule.selection_within_mainstem_cell: maximum D8 accumulation; ties resolved by row then column

allowed_for_generation: Copernicus DEM elevation and D8 topology
forbidden: read per-basin 2015 activation or severity labels
read post-event damage or severity descriptions
read post-anchor precipitation or remote-sensing response
drop or replace a candidate using observed 2015 response
tune the feeder accumulation floor against target or control outcomes
freeze_rule: The complete generated candidate pool and its SHA256 must be committed before any control-outcome adjudication. Documentary silence can never be converted to CONTROL.
